claim_boundary: This operational supplement removes implementation ambiguity from the already accepted outcome-free sampling design. It does not change sample sizes, analytical roles, scientific endpoints, the official seed, image allocation, or matcher measurements, and it does not authorize pair selection or outcome collection until owner acceptance and a passing capacity audit.

join_contract.execution_to_canonical_join: restricted_pair_execution_linkage.pair_execution_id is one-to-one with merged canonical_measurements.pair_execution_id and one-to-one with within_role_pair_frame.canonical_pair_id
join_contract.endpoint_requirement: both endpoint image IDs must occur exactly once in the official image-role allocation and automatic quality table
join_contract.duplicate_policy: any duplicate join key, missing row, unexpected row, role disagreement, endpoint disagreement, or hash mismatch is a fatal pre-sampling failure

numeric_parsing.decimal_input: parse finite base-10 decimal text without locale conversion
numeric_parsing.nonfinite_policy: NaN, positive infinity, and negative infinity are invalid
numeric_parsing.comparison_precision: use parsed numeric values without rounding before ranking; preserve original serialized values in the audit frame

percentile_rule.name: within_frame_midrank_empirical_percentile
percentile_rule.range: strictly greater than 0 and strictly less than 1 for nonempty frames
percentile_rule.tie_policy: equal numeric values receive the same percentile and are never split by pair or image ID

descriptor_derivation.canonical_descriptor_score: for each canonical pair and descriptor, take the maximum descriptor_similarity across all retained directions and memberships
descriptor_derivation.percentile_frame: pairs carrying that descriptor within the same frozen image-allocation role
descriptor_derivation.higher_score_direction: higher percentile means higher descriptor similarity
descriptor_derivation.dual_descriptor_disagreement: absolute difference between the two within-descriptor, within-role percentiles

image_quality_derivation.exposure_clipping_quality_direction: lower clipping fraction is better; rank negative exposure_clipping_fraction so lower quality percentiles indicate worse clipping
image_quality_derivation.pair_endpoint_summary: minimum of the two endpoint quality percentiles for each retained metric
image_quality_derivation.measurement_failure: true if either endpoint lacks any required valid retained image-quality measurement

local_correspondence_derivation.measurement_failure: canonical failure_code is not none or local_match_coverage_fraction is absent or nonfinite
local_correspondence_derivation.valid_zero_policy: a finite local_match_coverage_fraction equal to zero with failure_code none is a valid observed zero, not missing and not measurement failure
local_correspondence_derivation.percentile_frame: valid canonical local-match coverage values within the same frozen image-allocation role
local_correspondence_derivation.higher_coverage_direction: higher percentile means greater local correspondence

development_evidence_state.measurement_failure: any required endpoint image-quality failure or canonical local-correspondence measurement failure
development_evidence_state.evidence_stress: among otherwise valid pairs, at least one endpoint quality summary is in its bottom quintile, or local-correspondence coverage is in its within-role bottom quintile, or a dual-descriptor pair has descriptor-percentile disagreement in the within-role top quintile

mechanism_challenge_state.automatic_measurement_failure: any required endpoint image-quality failure or canonical local-correspondence measurement failure
mechanism_challenge_state.image_quality_stress: either endpoint has frozen image quality_state quality_stress_bottom_quintile
mechanism_challenge_state.local_correspondence_bottom_quintile: valid canonical coverage has within-confirmation-role percentile <= 0.20
mechanism_challenge_state.descriptor_exclusive: descriptor support is megadescriptor_only or dinov2_only
mechanism_challenge_state.dual_descriptor_percentile_disagreement_: both descriptors are present and their absolute within-role percentile difference has percentile >= 0.80 among dual-descriptor pairs in the eligible post-deployment mechanism frame

seed_derivation.key_bytes: decode the 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters as exactly 32 bytes
seed_derivation.message_serialization: UTF-8 JSON array with ensure_ascii=true and separators comma and colon, with no whitespace or trailing newline
seed_derivation.ordering_unit_id: use canonical_pair_id for within-cell pair ordering and the empty string for cell-level integer-allocation tie-breaking
seed_derivation.ordering: ascending hexadecimal HMAC digest, then ascending canonical_pair_id only for a theoretical digest collision
seed_derivation.prng: none; cryptographic hash ordering is the deterministic seeded permutation

required_outputs_before_selection: post-allocation capacity audit with PASS or INSUFFICIENT_FRAME_CAPACITY
